sentences.text: This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking to direct the 2nd respondent to consider the representation dated 09.08.2024 and conduct appropriate proceedings as directed by the 1st respondent in Na.Ka.No.Aa1/40505-10/2009 dated 27.08.2024.

2.Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner's land comprised in Survey New No.35/4B (Old No.35/4), New No.35/5B (Old No.35/5) & New No.35/6B (Old No.35/6), was acquired by the Government of Tamil Nadu for formation of new road gauge railway line between Tindivanam and Nagari.
Further, the award of compensation was also passed by the 1st https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
( Uploaded on: 13/10/2025 01:19:57 pm ) respondent in Na.Ka.No.Aa1/40405-10/2009 dated 22.06.2023.

Since the petitioner's land was undervalued, the petitioner made an application dated 09.08.2024 under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation Act, 2013 to the 1st respondent for enhanced compensation.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Considering the same, the 1st respondent passed an order in Na.Ka.No.Aa1/40505-10/2009 dated 27.08.2024, specifically directing the 2nd respondent to conduct appropriate proceedings before the concerned Court.
However, the 2nd respondent failed to refer the matter to the Civil Court.
Hence, the present writ petition has been filed.
3.Learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents would submit that within a period of two weeks time, the 2nd respondent will refer the matter to the Civil Court.
4.Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents.

opennyai_summary.facts:
Since the petitioner's land was undervalued, the petitioner made an application dated 09.08.2024 under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation Act, 2013 to the 1st respondent for enhanced compensation.
Considering the same, the 1st respondent passed an order in Na.Ka.No.Aa1/40505-10/2009 dated 27.08.2024, specifically directing the 2nd respondent to conduct appropriate proceedings before the concerned Court.
However, the 2nd respondent failed to refer the matter to the Civil Court.
opennyai_summary.decision:
5.Considering the submissions made by either parties and in view of the limited prayer sought for in this Writ Petition, without going into the merits of the case, this Court directs the 2nd respondent to refer the matter to the Civil Court for the purpose determining the higher compensation within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
6.With the above directions, this writ petition is disposed of.
